tender.title: Selection of RE Power Developers under Contract for Difference (CfD) Mechanism for assured Peak Supply of 1000 MWh (500 MW x 2 Hrs.) from ISTS-Connected RE Projects in India under Tariff-Based Competitive Bidding (SECI-CfD-I)

docs.title: RfS
docs.summary: The tender as revised on 15.07.2026 (it replaces the RfS of the same number dated 17.04.2026): 500 MW of assured peak supply, 2 MWh per MW every evening through the power exchanges, settled against the strike price by SECI's CfD Pool; the bid, the e-Reverse Auction, eligibility, guarantees, milestones and the formats (Section 7). Read with the amendments, which override it.

docs.title: Standard CfD Agreement (CfDA)
docs.summary: The agreement every winner signs: the daily supply, the time-block settlement against the strike price, the weekly shortfall penalty, the Letter of Credit, the events of default. It prevails over the RfS where they differ (CfDA 1.2.18).

docs.title: Amendment-01
docs.summary: SECI keeps the CfD Pool funded for the whole term; gains above ₹10/kWh split 50:50 (the sharing itself was later replaced by Amendment-03's full pass-through).

docs.title: Amendment-02
docs.summary: A battery of X MW / 2X MWh owned by the bidder becomes mandatory; the SCD applies to the battery (15 months) with the RE generation due by 36 months; the green-market share (25%, plus 75% for charging until month 36, then 50% from group companies); the penalties re-cut for the two deadlines.

docs.title: Amendment-03
docs.summary: The term becomes 15 years; the ₹5.80/kWh ceiling goes; the CfD settlement becomes a full pass-through (the bidder nets the strike price on every kWh, the Pool keeps every gain and bears every loss); TAM and G-TAM join the markets; SECI may designate the hours and bid on the RPD's behalf; the EMD validity rule; a new contact.

docs.title: Amendment-04
docs.summary: How SECI's designation of the Peak Hours works: the RPD declares the day's availability (MWh) by 06:00 on D-1, or 100% of the contracted capacity is deemed available; SECI instructs the time blocks, price and quantum by 08:00 on D-1, or bids on the RPD's behalf; up to 80% of the availability may go through TAM/G-TAM and the balance through the day-ahead markets, never above the contracted capacity in a block; deviations, DSM and every exchange charge are the RPD's; sale elsewhere when MCPs stay below the strike price needs SECI/MNRE approval. And SECI may restrict the capacity awarded to what the CfD corpus can bear at the discovered tariff.

ev.label: Capacity you may bid
ev.display: One bid for you and your group: 50 to 150 MW cumulative, in whole MW
ev.quote: submit a single bid offering a minimum quantum of cumulative Contracted Capacity of 50 MW and a maximum quantum of 150 MW, in the prescribed formats. The cumulative Contracted Capacity shall be quoted in integral values only.

ev.label: What you bid
ev.display: One strike price in ₹/kWh for all projects applied for; digits after two decimals are ignored
ev.quote: quoting a single “First Round Tariff” in Indian Rupee per kWh for all the Projects applied for. If it is quoted with more than two digits after decimal, digits after first two decimal places shall be ignored.

ev.label: Ceiling tariff
ev.display: None: the ₹5.80/kWh ceiling of the RfS was removed by Amendment-03
ev.quote: The tariff has to be less than or equal to INR 5.80/kWh

ev.label: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD)
ev.display: ₹9.68 lakh/MW solar + ₹13.68 lakh/MW wind or other RE + ₹2.40 lakh/MWh battery, as a bank guarantee or surety bond with the bid
ev.quote: Earnest Money Deposit = [INR 9,68,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of Solar PV component (MW) + INR 13,68,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of Wind component and other RE generating sources (MW) + INR 2,40,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of the ESS component (MWh)].

ev.label: Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG)
ev.display: ₹24.20 lakh/MW solar + ₹34.20 lakh/MW wind or other RE + ₹6.00 lakh/MWh battery, on the installed (AC) capacities
ev.quote: Performance Bank Guarantee = [INR 24,20,000 x Rated Installed Capacity of Solar component (MW) + INR 34,20,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of Wind component and other RE generating sources (MW) + INR 6,00,000 x Rated cumulative Installed Capacity of the ESS component (MWh)].

ev.label: SECI may set the hours
ev.display: SECI may designate the Peak Hours and time blocks; you must make the power available in them and sell it on the exchanges as it instructs
ev.quote: SECI shall have the right, as deemed necessary, to designate the Peak Hours (including specific Time-Blocks) during which the RPD shall make available and sell power from the Project through the Power Exchanges. The RPD shall ensure availability of power during the Peak Hours/Time-Blocks so designated by SECI

ev.label: Declare the day's availability by 06:00 on D-1
ev.display: In MWh, day-ahead; the declaration drives what SECI schedules
ev.quote: The RPD shall declare the availability of energy from the Project, in MWh, on a day-ahead basis, latest by 06:00 hours on the day immediately preceding the day of delivery (‘D-1’ Day for delivery on Day ‘D’).

ev.label: Up to 80% term-ahead, the rest day-ahead
ev.display: TAM/G-TAM may take up to 80% of the declared availability; the balance goes to DAM/GDAM/HP-DAM; never above the contracted capacity in any block, never sold twice
ev.quote: For the purpose of sale of power through the TAM and G-TAM, up to 80% of the availability shall be considered for offering/scheduling, as applicable, in the aforesaid markets

ev.label: SECI may award less than 500 MW
ev.display: The capacity awarded is what the CfD corpus can carry at the discovered tariff; SECI may restrict the total award
ev.quote: the final capacity to be awarded under the RfS shall be determined by SECI based on an assessment of the financial viability of the discovered Tariff and the corresponding requirement of the CfD Pool, within the available CfD corpus. Accordingly, SECI reserves the right to restrict the total capacity to be awarded under the RfS, as considered necessary, to ensure that the financial implications of the award remain within the available CfD corpus.

changes.effect: The agreement's settlement article rewritten: you neither retain any gain nor bear any loss between the market price and the strike price.
changes.diff: <ins>Sharing of Profit/ Gains and Losses: The profit/gain and loss arising from the sale of electricity by the RPD through the Power Exchanges shall be settled between the RPD and the CfD Stabilization Fund (“CfD Pool”) in respect of each Time-Block, such that the RPD shall be entitled to receive the Strike Price (“SP”) for the electricity supplied from the Project, subject to the following: a. In case the MCP is higher than the SP: The amount corresponding to the difference between the MCP and the SP, i.e. (MCP – SP), shall constitute the profit/gain for the respective Time-Block. The entire amount of such profit/gain shall be passed on by the RPD to the CfD Pool. b. In case the MCP is lower than the SP: The RPD shall be compensated from the CfD Pool for the difference between the SP and the MCP, i.e. (SP – MCP), for the respective Time-Block, such that the RPD receives an amount equivalent to the SP for the electricity supplied from the Project. c. In case the MCP is equal to the SP: No amount shall be payable by either the RPD or the CfD Pool on account of gain or loss for the respective Time-Block. For avoidance of doubt, the entire profit/gain arising from the difference between MCP and SP, where MCP is higher than SP, shall accrue to the CfD Pool, and the entire loss arising from the difference between SP and MCP, where MCP is lower than SP, shall be borne by the CfD Pool. Accordingly, the RPD shall neither retain any profit/gain nor bear any loss on account of variation between the MCP and the SP. While calculating the profit/gain or loss, rounding off the difference between MCP and SP shall not be carried out. The settlement of profit/gains or losses between the CfD Pool and the RPD shall be inclusive of applicable taxes, if any.</ins>

levers.label: Own solar
levers.what: Your own solar, co-located with the battery. Fill it and charge the battery from it instead of the market.
levers.why: Own solar replaces bought charging power (about ₹2.2/kWh) and sells its surplus at midday prices, against about ₹4 cr of capex per MWac. The first MW lower the price a lot; past the size that fills the battery the surplus sells for less than it costs, and the price turns up again. This is the lever the optimiser sets.

levers.label: Battery energy
levers.what: Battery energy per contracted MW. The tender needs at least 2 (2 hours at full power).
levers.why: More than 2 MWh per MW buys headroom for degradation and bad days, but it is capex (about ₹1 cr per MWh) that earns nothing on a normal day, so the price rises. Below 2 is not allowed.

levers.label: Extra battery for evening sale
levers.what: Battery beyond the tender's 2 MWh per MW, kept for selling in the evening hours outside your two peak hours, once the day's commitment is met.
levers.why: It earns the market price on those evenings (the Pool does not settle it) but costs capex, O&M, augmentation and charging power. It lowers the price only when the evening hours left after your peak pay more than that cost over 15 years.

levers.label: Principal moratorium
levers.what: Years after the COD in which only interest is paid, no principal (the moratorium).
levers.why: Later principal means more cash to the equity in the early years, which the IRR values most, so the price falls slightly.

levers.label: Battery capex (all-in)
levers.what: All-in battery capex per MWh: cells, PCS, civil, EMS, everything up to the pooling station.
levers.why: The largest single cost of the bid: 200 MWh at ₹1 cr is ₹200 cr of the project. Every ₹0.01 cr per MWh is ₹2 cr of capex to recover over 15 years, so the price moves almost one to one with it.

levers.label: Target equity IRR
levers.what: The return your equity asks for, after tax. The strike price is solved so that the equity earns exactly this.
levers.why: The price is the direct answer to this number: a higher target needs a higher price. If you can live with a lower return, this is the cheapest rupee to find on bid day.

levers.label: Debt share
levers.what: The share of the project cost funded by loans; the rest is your equity.
levers.why: Debt at 9% is cheaper than equity at 14%, so more debt lowers the price, until the DSCR falls below what the lender accepts.

levers.label: Receivable days
levers.what: Days between selling the energy and receiving the money, which sets the working capital you must fund.
levers.why: More days tie up more cash at the working-capital interest rate, so the price rises a little.

levers.label: Plant availability
levers.what: The share of the daily 2 MWh per MW you expect to deliver, after outages and curtailment.
levers.why: Energy not delivered earns nothing and, beyond 10% a week, is penalised; so lower availability needs a higher price on the energy you do deliver.

levers.label: Pre-operative & IDC
levers.what: Pre-operative expenses and interest during construction, as a share of the hard cost.
levers.why: Added to the project cost before a unit is sold, so a higher share means a higher price.

levers.label: Transmission to the ISTS substation
levers.what: The line and bay from the plant to the ISTS substation, per contracted MW.
levers.why: A fixed cost of the connection; dearer evacuation means a higher price.

levers.label: Battery O&M
levers.what: Battery operation and maintenance per MWh a year.
levers.why: A yearly cost on the whole battery for 15 years; higher O&M, higher price.

upload.text: This is SECI's first Contract for Difference tender. Six documents, two hundred and sixteen pages: the request for selection, the agreement, and four amendments. Drop them in together. TenderOS identifies each one, puts them in order, and starts reading.

hi.text: यह SECI का पहला Contract for Difference टेंडर है। छह दस्तावेज़, दो सौ सोलह पेज: रिक्वेस्ट फ़ॉर सिलेक्शन, एग्रीमेंट और चार अमेंडमेंट। इन्हें एक साथ डाल दीजिए। TenderOS हर दस्तावेज़ को पहचानता है, उन्हें क्रम में रखता है और पढ़ना शुरू कर देता है।

read.text: Every value it reads is tied to its page. Click a condition, and the tender opens at the exact sentence it came from. Nothing reaches the bid until a reviewer has confirmed the reading.

hi.text: यह जो भी वैल्यू पढ़ता है, वह अपने पेज से जुड़ी रहती है। किसी शर्त पर क्लिक कीजिए, और टेंडर ठीक उसी वाक्य पर खुलता है जहाँ से वह ली गई है। जब तक रिव्यूअर पढ़े हुए की पुष्टि न कर दे, कुछ भी बिड तक नहीं पहुँचता।

amend.text: Amendments are where bids go wrong. Here are all forty changes, word by word: what was struck out, what was added, and SECI's own page beside it. The ceiling tariff removed. The battery made mandatory. The award tied to SECI's corpus.

hi.text: बिड अक्सर अमेंडमेंट में ही चूकती है। यहाँ सभी चालीस बदलाव शब्द-दर-शब्द हैं: क्या हटाया गया, क्या जोड़ा गया, और साथ में SECI का अपना पेज। सीलिंग टैरिफ़ हटा दिया गया। बैटरी अनिवार्य कर दी गई। अवॉर्ड को SECI के कॉर्पस से जोड़ दिया गया।

conditions.text: Two hundred and sixty-two conditions, each with its clause. The ones that depend on the plant are tested on every design, so a bid that breaks the tender is flagged before the bid committee ever sees it.

hi.text: दो सौ बासठ शर्तें, हर एक अपने क्लॉज़ के साथ। जो शर्तें प्लांट पर निर्भर करती हैं, उन्हें हर डिज़ाइन पर परखा जाता है, ताकि टेंडर तोड़ने वाली बिड, बिड कमेटी के सामने आने से पहले ही पकड़ में आ जाए।

team.text: Projects, design and finance each own their inputs. Ask a colleague from any box, attach the supplier's offer as evidence, and have the bid head sign off. If the value changes later, the sign-off turns amber.

hi.text: प्रोजेक्ट्स, डिज़ाइन और फ़ाइनेंस, हर टीम अपने इनपुट सँभालती है। किसी भी बॉक्स से सहकर्मी से पूछिए, सप्लायर का ऑफ़र प्रमाण के रूप में जोड़िए, और बिड हेड से साइन-ऑफ़ लीजिए। बाद में वैल्यू बदली, तो साइन-ऑफ़ एम्बर हो जाता है।

studio.text: Now design the plant. Move own solar, wind, battery cost, or the return you want, and the strike price, the project cost and the tender's conditions follow at once. Every point is a full fifteen-year simulation. Take the mouse and try it yourself.

hi.text: अब प्लांट डिज़ाइन कीजिए। अपना सोलर, विंड, बैटरी की लागत या मनचाहा रिटर्न बदलिए, और स्ट्राइक प्राइस, प्रोजेक्ट की लागत और टेंडर की शर्तें तुरंत साथ बदलती हैं। हर बिंदु पंद्रह साल का पूरा सिमुलेशन है। माउस लीजिए और ख़ुद आज़माइए।

size.text: The optimiser searches every plant. Too little solar, and some evenings fall short. Too much, and the solar costs more than the power it replaces. Add wind, and on this tender the price rises. It keeps the lowest price that still meets the tender every single day.

hi.text: ऑप्टिमाइज़र हर प्लांट को परखता है। सोलर कम हो, तो कुछ शामों की सप्लाई कम पड़ जाती है। ज़्यादा हो, तो सोलर उस बिजली से महँगा पड़ता है जिसकी जगह वह लेता है। विंड जोड़ने पर इस टेंडर में क़ीमत बढ़ जाती है। यह वही सबसे कम क़ीमत रखता है जो हर एक दिन टेंडर की शर्त पूरी करे।

dispatch.text: Then it proves the result. Every day of fifteen years, in fifteen-minute blocks: when the battery charges, from which source, and when it supplies the evening peak. More than half a million blocks, ready as a compliance file.

hi.text: फिर यह नतीजे को साबित करता है। पंद्रह साल का हर दिन, पंद्रह-पंद्रह मिनट के ब्लॉक में: बैटरी कब चार्ज होती है, किस स्रोत से, और शाम के पीक में कब सप्लाई देती है। पाँच लाख से ज़्यादा ब्लॉक, कम्प्लायंस फ़ाइल के रूप में तैयार।

finance.text: Behind the price is a complete financial model: construction, debt sculpted to the lender's cover ratio, tax and working capital. Click any figure to see what it rests on. The same model downloads as a live Excel workbook.

hi.text: इस क़ीमत के पीछे एक पूरा फ़ाइनेंशियल मॉडल है: निर्माण, लेंडर के कवर रेशियो के अनुसार ढला हुआ क़र्ज़, टैक्स और वर्किंग कैपिटल। किसी भी आँकड़े पर क्लिक कीजिए और देखिए कि वह किस पर टिका है। यही मॉडल लाइव Excel वर्कबुक के रूप में डाउनलोड होता है।

whatif.text: On bid day, choose the price you want to quote. TenderOS shows what each lever is worth, and plans the surest route there, with the chance of each move. Turn a lever down, and it finds another way.

hi.text: बिड के दिन, वह क़ीमत चुनिए जो आप कोट करना चाहते हैं। TenderOS दिखाता है कि हर लीवर का असर कितना है, और वहाँ तक पहुँचने का सबसे पक्का रास्ता बनाता है, यह बताते हुए कि हर क़दम कितना संभव है। कोई लीवर नामंज़ूर कीजिए, तो यह दूसरा रास्ता खोज लेता है।

wins.text: Will this price win? SECI's pool pays, or collects, the difference between the strike price and the market. After the fourth amendment, SECI may award only what its corpus can carry. So the bid is tested against the pool as well.

hi.text: क्या यह क़ीमत जीतेगी? SECI का पूल स्ट्राइक प्राइस और बाज़ार के बीच का अंतर चुकाता है, या वसूलता है। चौथे अमेंडमेंट के बाद SECI उतना ही अवॉर्ड दे सकता है जितना उसका कॉर्पस उठा सके। इसलिए बिड को पूल के सामने भी परखा जाता है।

review.text: Before submission, the bid is reviewed against the tender's rules, the lender's ratios, and what the market has actually paid. A sound bid passes. An over-built one is told exactly what is wrong, and where to fix it.

hi.text: जमा करने से पहले बिड की समीक्षा होती है: टेंडर के नियमों, लेंडर के रेशियो और बाज़ार ने असल में जो क़ीमत दी है, उसके सामने। सही बिड पास हो जाती है। ज़रूरत से बड़ा प्लांट हो, तो साफ़ बताया जाता है कि ग़लती क्या है और कहाँ सुधारनी है।

pack.text: And the bid pack is ready: the Excel model, the tender's formats as letters, the fifteen-minute dispatch, the conditions checklist and the evidence register. Months of bid work, done in hours. Talk to jouleWise to see it on your own tender.

hi.text: और बिड पैक तैयार है: Excel मॉडल, टेंडर के फ़ॉर्मेट पत्रों के रूप में, पंद्रह मिनट का डिस्पैच, शर्तों की चेकलिस्ट और प्रमाण रजिस्टर। महीनों का बिड का काम, घंटों में। इसे अपने टेंडर पर देखने के लिए jouleWise से बात कीजिए।
